notes.title: Triple Take Forever Money Distribution Patch
notes.notes:
Hi folks, We've updated the distribution of money in endless mode to make some of the grindy achievements a tad less grindy. The amount of money given per stage now increases with a streak up to 10, so beating the first level in a run still awards one coin, but the tenth one gives 10 coins, and the seventeenth still gives just 10. 

Thanks for the feedback on the mode! We hope you continue to enjoy Triple Take!

notes.title: Triple Take Forever Patch
notes.notes: Sorry folks! Looks like we left a bug in the game that caused a crash when dying on any regular level! This has been fixed now, sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Triple Take Demo Patch!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41119595/3b1c552f306cecf1920534202cc79dd8e8dd23d0.png[/img]

A patch has been released for the Triple Take demo! This patch fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed an bug that could occur on the fourth stage that got the player stuck dying forever to the cannon.

[*] Adjusted visual effects on the end cutscene to make the text easier to read.

[*] Adjusted how wall jumping works as many users were finding it inconsistent.
[/list]
